_comment: Example marker positions file for elevated backdrop
_note: This example is for a backdrop elevated 10cm above floor

_explanation.scenario: Backdrop markings show 10cm and 200cm, but backdrop is 10cm off the ground
_explanation.calculation: Actual heights from floor = backdrop marking + 10cm elevation
_explanation.horizontal: x values represent horizontal position in cm (0cm = left edge, 200cm = right edge)
